reply.text:
Welcome back. Whether you train on day 2 is a question about soreness, and "everything hurts" is one I can't read for you. If it's ordinary post-workout stiffness, that's a training question I can help with, but if anything feels sharp, swollen or wrong, that's one for a doctor or physio, not a coach.

On the training side, most people coming back after years off do better with a lighter second session or a rest day than going hard again straight away. If you want to move, an easy walk or a light session with weights well under what you used on day 1 is a fair call. Tell me what you did yesterday and what's on your plan today, and I'll help you decide how to approach it.
